newsitem.title: USA: Diana knows no reason for stock activity.
newsitem.headline: Diana knows no reason for stock activity.

text.p: Diana Corp on Monday said it was unaware of any corporate development that could account for the unusual trading activity in its stock.
Diana shares was down 1-1/8 to 11-1/4 in late trading on the New York Stock Exchnage.
Last week, Diana announced the sale of the assets of its meat and seafood subsidiary, Atlanta Provision Co, and said it would take charges of $2.0 million as a result of the transaction.
The company, which provides telecommunications equipment for public switched telephone networks, also said it sold three additional switches to Lightcom International.
Diana said it was also aware that a former Diana officer sold a large block of its shares last month.
